title: Two-line element parsing
summary: From raw text to a structured element set: line classification, checksum verification, field extraction, and the cross checks.

nodes.label: Input text
nodes.summary: One, two, or three lines; blank lines are ignored and any of the common line endings is accepted.
nodes.summary_zh: 一行、两行或三行；忽略空行，接受各种常见换行符。

nodes.label: Split and classify lines
nodes.summary: A leading line that does not begin with '1 ' is the satellite name; the next two lines are the data lines.
nodes.summary_zh: 不以 "1 " 开头的首行是卫星名称；其后两行是数据行。

nodes.label: Two data lines?
nodes.summary: The format requires exactly two data lines.
nodes.summary_zh: 格式要求恰好两行数据。

nodes.label: TooShort
nodes.summary: Fewer than two data lines were present.

nodes.label: Verify line 1 checksum
nodes.summary: Sum the digits and the minus signs of the first 68 columns modulo ten and compare with column 69.
nodes.summary_zh: 对前 68 列的十进制数字与负号求和后对十取模，与第 69 列比较。

nodes.label: Checksums match?
nodes.summary: Each line is verified independently, so a corrupted line is reported with its number.
nodes.summary_zh: 每行独立校验，因此损坏的行会连同行号一起报告。

nodes.label: Checksum error
nodes.summary: A line checksum does not match its contents.
nodes.summary_zh: 某行校验和与其内容不一致。

nodes.label: Read line 1 fields
nodes.summary: Catalog number, classification, designator, epoch, the two derivatives, BSTAR, and the element set number.
nodes.summary_zh: 编目号、密级、国际编号、历元、两个导数、BSTAR 与元素集编号。

nodes.label: Read line 2 fields
nodes.summary: Inclination, right ascension, eccentricity, argument of perigee, mean anomaly, mean motion, and the revolution number.
nodes.summary_zh: 倾角、赤经、偏心率、近地点幅角、平近点角、平均运动与圈数。

nodes.label: Decode exponent fields
nodes.summary: A sign, a mantissa with an assumed decimal point, an exponent sign, and one exponent digit.
nodes.summary_zh: 尾数符号、带隐含小数点的尾数、指数符号与一位指数数字。

nodes.label: Expand the two digit year
nodes.summary: Years 57 through 99 are in the twentieth century and 00 through 56 in the twenty-first.
nodes.summary_zh: 57 至 99 属于二十世纪，00 至 56 属于二十一世纪。

nodes.label: Catalog numbers match?
nodes.summary: The two lines must describe the same object.
nodes.summary_zh: 两行必须描述同一目标。

nodes.label: MismatchedElementSet
nodes.summary: The two lines carry different element set numbers.
nodes.summary_zh: 两行携带不同的元素集编号。

nodes.label: TwoLineElement
nodes.summary: The structured element set, with the units of the format preserved.
nodes.summary_zh: 结构化元素集，保留格式所用的单位。

summary_zh: 从原始文本到结构化元素集：行分类、校验和验证、字段提取与交叉检查。
